title: デビュー戦の後に・Der Anfang

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash makes her debut without a hitch, but she seems concerned about something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With so many of her contemporaries being standouts, she'll have to approach the Keisei Hai with care for any hope of success in the Classic Triple Crown.
